name: Risk-off defensive relative pair
hypothesis: Pair a liquid resilient long with an authorized weaker short after both relative trend and broad risk-off conditions confirm.
spec: Setup: Some established memes may decline less than fragile peers during risk reduction. Entry: Pair a liquid resilient long with an authorized weaker short after both relative trend and broad risk-off conditions confirm. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on spread reversal, borrow change, or market-regime recovery. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs chain activity, network cost or depth data beyond exchange price bars
